note: Our own maps of the real Florida coast, drawn from public-domain census data. Map pixels: x grows east, y grows south. x = (lon - lon0) * ppd * cos; y = (lat1 - lat) * ppd.

leonida.jpg.shows: the whole state: the coast, the Keys, the regions

cornerbug-A.shows: cornerbug-A's Florida outline (dot_x, dot_y; viewBox 0 0 659.1 1000). It was traced from leonida.jpg scaled to 1000 units tall, so it is leonida.jpg's projection times 1000/5040. Ten coast landmarks (Key West to Jupiter Inlet, Naples, Cape Sable) sit within 1 unit (0.3 km) of its coast.
